tools.name: describe_service
tools.description: Say what Vari8ion is, who it is for, its two services, the price, what it needs and what it keeps. Call it first if the client asks what this is.

tools.name: get_activation_steps
tools.description: Return every step to sign up one project, in call order, and what happens after the last step.

tools.name: start_project_link
tools.description: Start linking one project to Vari8ion. Returns the link_id, the price and the OneDrive share steps.

tools.name: get_share_steps
tools.description: Return the share steps for one account type, if the client's account differs from the one given at the start.

tools.name: set_contract_folder
tools.description: Record where the bid and contract folder is. It holds the tender or bid, the signed contract, its schedules and any amendments. Needed.

tools.name: set_drawings_folder
tools.description: Record where the technical drawings folder is. It holds the drawings, their revisions and the drawing register. Needed.

tools.name: set_daily_records_folder
tools.description: Record where the daily records folder is. It holds site diaries, daily reports, photos, dockets and timesheets. Needed.

tools.name: set_correspondence_folder
tools.description: Record where the correspondence folder is. It holds emails, letters, RFIs and meeting minutes. Optional.

tools.name: set_variations_folder
tools.description: Record where the variations folder is. It holds variation requests, instructions and change orders. Optional.

tools.name: set_programme_folder
tools.description: Record where the programme folder is. It holds the programme or schedule and its updates. Optional.

tools.name: get_link_status
tools.description: Show one link: the service, the folders given, the needed folders still missing, whether it was sent, and the next call.

tools.name: send_project_link
tools.description: Send the OneDrive share link and the folders to Vari8ion as a request. Call it after the folder tools. It can be sent once for each link_id.
